title: Ultra raises $62M to expand its AI-powered warehouse packing robots
key_facts: Ultra has raised $62 million, including a $50 million Series A led by Framework, with participation from Y Combinator.
The money is to expand deployment of its OP1 packing and fulfilment robot and build installation, servicing and support operations.
Y Combinator said Ultra's robots operate in warehouses across the US and have packed more than 500,000 orders.
Ultra uses a robot-as-a-service model: an installation fee plus a recurring subscription covering hardware, software and support.
Ultra works with Physical Intelligence, which provides AI models; Ultra builds and deploys the robots.
Co-founder and CEO Jon Miller Schwartz said in an X post the company deployed robots in customer sites early to shape OP1.
